div.div: مُعَصِّلٌ An arrow that twists when it is shot: (S, O, K:) or, accord. to 'Alee Ibn-Hamzeh, it is correctly مُعَضِّلٌ, with the pointed ض; from عَضَّلَتْ meaning “ the egg twisted, or became difficult [to be excluded], in her inside. ” (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
